subject: general
question: Ketan and Kunal can complete a job together in 7 days. Kunal is (7)/(4) times as efficient as Ketan. In how many days can Kunal alone complete the job?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Efficiency ratio of **Kunal** to **Ketan** = 7 : 4.

Combined efficiency = 7 + 4 = 11 units/day.

Total work = Combined efficiency × Total days = 11 × 7 = 77 units.

Days for **Kunal** = Total work ÷ Kunal efficiency = 77 ÷ 7 = 11 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 11 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by **Ketan** and **Kunal** together = 7 days.

**Efficiency Ratio:**

⇒ Efficiency of **Kunal** = 7/4 × Efficiency of **Ketan**

⇒ Kunal : Ketan = 7 : 4

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Efficiency = 7 + 4 = 11 units/day

⇒ Total Work = 11 units/day × 7 days = 77 units

⇒ Time taken by **Kunal** alone = 77 ÷ 7

⇒ Time taken by **Kunal** alone = 11 days

**∴ The correct answer is 11 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Efficiency and Time Relationship

Efficiency is inversely proportional to the time taken to complete a task. Efficiency = Work ÷ Time.

Total Work Formula

Total Work = (Efficiency₁ + Efficiency₂) × Combined Time.

Individual Time Calculation

Time taken by an individual = Total Work ÷ Individual Efficiency.</p
